verdict.rationale: stagewise offers no documented region or residency selector. Its enterprise tier does list 'optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud', which is the product's own way to control where its cloud data lives, and BYOK or self-hosted models can keep requests off the managed service. Missing for 10: an explicit region/data-residency selection, documentation of what data the stagewise Cloud stores and where, availability outside the enterprise tier, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud
No requests go through the stagewise managed service
Full control, zero external API calls.
